authentication.session: GET /session returns {account:null|{id,username},profiles:[{id,label,createdAt}],csrfToken}; the first request creates an anonymous HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie
authentication.login: POST /login {username,password}; returns the session shape and rotates cookie and csrfToken
authentication.logout: POST /logout {}; clears authenticated cookie; fetch /session again before next login

routes.GET /capabilities: public registry catalog; {objectives:[...],...}; never contains answers
routes.PUT /profiles/:id/saves/:moduleId: {expectedRevision:0|positive integer,schemaVersion:1,payload:object,mutationId:string} -> {save:snapshot}; all saves are unverified practice state. assessment:* is server-owned
routes.POST /profiles/:id/legacy-import: {idempotencyKey,records:[{key,value}]} -> {import:{id,status:'legacy/unverified',recordCount,createdAt},creditsDelta:0}; only call after explicit client confirmation; never delete local source
routes.GET /profiles/:id/attempts/:attemptId: {attempt}; issued assessment contains no solution. submitted attempt includes immutable original responses, current result, explanations and gradeHistory of original and appended revisions
routes.GET /profiles/:id/growth: {totals:{credits,points,submittedAttempts,buckets},moduleContributions:[{moduleId,credits,points}],trends:[{date,delta,credits}],buckets:[{bucketKey,objectiveId,moduleId,difficulty,grade,bestScore,credits,first,latest,best,items:[{itemKey,first,latest,best,firstCorrect}]}],ledger:[...],legacy:{imports,records},unit:{unitsPerPoint:100,bucketMaximum:10000},description}; scores are observed assessment results, not an exact mastery estimate

conflicts.revision_conflict: HTTP 409 {code:'revision_conflict',current:snapshot|null}; keep both copies until explicit resolution
conflicts.idempotency_conflict: HTTP 409 {code:'idempotency_conflict'} when the same key is reused with different request content
conflicts.attempt_finalized: HTTP 409 {code:'attempt_finalized'} for a different submission after finalization; same key and same content replay the original result

grading.growth: max(0,newBest-oldBest); fixed objective+grade/difficulty+compatible rule bucket; 100 points maximum per bucket
grading.distribution: largest remainder with stable item ordering, proportional to server graded earned score; zero-earned items receive no positive credit
grading.completion: each finalized attempt atomically records completion and an assessment:objectiveId save revision
grading.internalRevision: CLI only; append immutable grade revisions and signed correction/reversal ledger entries; no client ledger write API

publicWordProblemInput.approval: Human approval stays false with truthful assistant review. All 1391 non-quarantined questions remain available in ordinary classified practice; only the original 7 problem questions are isolated. There is no fixed practice/exam split or source/family eligibility gate. A fixed server release fingerprint binds issued/grading content.
publicWordProblemInput.parts: A text item may publish parts:[{key,label,unit,type:'text'|'choice',placeholder,requireSimplified,requirePercent,choices?}], without any answer value. Render ordinary child-facing fields, internally serialize exact part keys and raw string values as one JSON string response. Tuple grader rejects missing/extra fields, non-string values, or part values exceeding 80 characters; whole response is limited to 2000 characters.
publicWordProblemInput.family: Source/story/family are provenance only. All mapped questions use the existing canonical math objective, grade/difficulty, fixedCount, compatible/reward version 1 and the same historical-best cap as native questions. Small classified pools use the original same-objective/difficulty native issuer to fill the original fixedCount; no new goals or reward buckets.
publicWordProblemInput.selection: GET /capabilities publishes wordProblemSources.assessmentSelections with selectionId, Chinese context, objectiveId, difficulty, original fixedCount, availableQuestions and nativeSupplementCount. Issued sourceContext records curatedQuestionCount and nativeSupplementCount. A single mapped classified question is usable; families do not gate issuance. Specific unresolved goal mappings are listed for decision while practice remains available.

currentClassroom.spaceflight: Current 0.5.0 classroom has 63 stages. Only Node /mathphysics/lessons/spaceflight/ HTML responses inject an ordered sync bridge and no-store cache policy; original disk course, static-root serving and file:// remain the current unmodified zero-credit classroom.
currentClassroom.static: Without the optional API, all native practice and previews are zero-credit local records. New formal assessments require online server issuance.
